ARB1.claim: Indian citizens need a tourist eILP, valid for stays of up to 14 days (children under 14 travel on an accompanying adult's); foreign nationals need a PAP/RAP, applied for through an approved local tour operator, plus a USD 30 royalty per head.

evidence.quote: eILP is applicable for Indian citizens only. Foreign Nationals may apply for PAP/RAP.
Tourist eILP is applicable for stay up to 14 days only.
Individual eILP is not required for those below 14 years of age.

Foreign tourists visiting Arunachal Pradesh shall have to payUSD 30 per head as Royalty to the Govt of Arunachal Pradesh and applications for PAP are to be applied through approved local tour operator only.

ARB2.claim: Ziro's nearest airports are Lilabari (about 123 km, 4–5 hours) and Hollongi near Itanagar (about 135 km, 3–4 hours).

evidence.quote: Lilabari Airport (IXI) is the nearest airport, located approximately 123 km from Ziro.
the journey takes around 4–5 hours
Hollongi Airport (HGI), near Itanagar, is about 135 km from Ziro and offers a convenient air access point, followed by a 3–4 hour road journey.

ARB3.claim: The best time for Ziro is spring (March–May) and autumn (September–November); the Ziro Music Festival is in September.

evidence.quote: The best time to visit Ziro Valley is during spring (March-May) and autumn (September-November)
the Ziro Music Festival which is held in September

ARB4.claim: Around Ziro: Kile Pakho viewpoint, Pine Grove 3 km from Old Ziro, Siikhe Lake 2.5 km from Hapoli, and Tarin Fish Farm, which shows the Apatani paddy-cum-fish system.

evidence.quote: Kile Pakho offers sweeping panoramic views
Located just 3 km from Old Ziro, Pine Grove
Siikhe Lake lies about 2.5 km from Hapoli town
Tarin Fish Farm showcases the Apatani tribe’s traditional paddy-cum-pisciculture system

ARB5.claim: Shri Siddheshwar Nath Temple in Ziro has a naturally formed Shiva lingam about 25 ft high.

evidence.quote: Shri Siddheshwar Nath Temple in Ziro houses the world's tallest naturally formed Shiva Lingam, which is about 25 ft high and 22 ft wide

ARB6.claim: Itanagar's nearest airports are Donyi Polo (Hollongi), Lilabari and Jorhat; the railway station is Naharlagun.

evidence.quote: Nearest Airports : Donyi Polo Airport (HGI) Lilabari Airport (North Lakhimpur) (IXI) Jorhat Airport (JRH)
Nearest Railway Station : Naharlagun Railway Station (NHLN)

ARB7.claim: Tawang's nearest airports are Guwahati and Tezpur; the railway station is Rangapara.

evidence.quote: Nearest Airports : Lokpriya Gopinath Bordoloi International Airport (GAU), Guwahati Tezpur Airport (Salonibari Air Force Station) (TEZ), Tezpur
Nearest Railway Station : Rangapara Railway Station (RPAN)

ARB10.claim: Itanagar, the capital of Arunachal Pradesh, takes its name from the 15th-century Ita Fort.

evidence.quote: Itanagar, the capital city of Arunachal Pradesh
the iconic Ita Fort , from which the city derives its name

ARB11.claim: The Jawaharlal Nehru State Museum holds textiles, handicrafts and archaeological finds; Ganga Lake (Gyakar Sinyi) in old forest is good for boating.

evidence.quote: The museum houses an exquisite collection of textiles, handicrafts, and archaeological finds
Ganga Lake, also known as Gyakar Sinyi, is a tranquil spot nestled amidst primeval forest, ideal for boating

ARB12.claim: The best time to visit is October to April.

evidence.quote: The best time to visit Itanagar is from October to April

ARB13.claim: Local food leans on bamboo shoots, fish and greens; thukpa and momos are popular.

evidence.quote: It is often accompanied by bamboo shoots, fish, and green leafy vegetables.
One must try local delicacies like Thukpa, a noodle soup, and Momos

ARB14.claim: It is open 8 am to 4 pm.

evidence.quote: Opening time - 08:00 AM Closing time - 04:00 PM

ARB15.claim: Talley Valley, about 30–32 km north-east of Ziro, is a 337 sq km sanctuary set up in 1995, rising from 1,200 to 3,000 m with silver fir forest; best October–April.

evidence.quote: Located about 30–32 kilometres northeast of Ziro Valley
Established in 1995
Spread across approximately 337 square kilometres, the sanctuary ranges in elevation from 1,200 to 3,000 metres
The ideal time to visit the Wildlife Sanctuary is between October and April

ARB16.claim: Ziro, at about 1,500 m and 165 km from Itanagar, is home to the Apatani and their paddy-cum-fish farming; it was shortlisted for UNESCO in 2012.

evidence.quote: Located at an elevation of about 1,500 metres, nearly 165 km from Itanagar
Shortlisted in 2012 for UNESCO World Heritage Site status, the valley is renowned for its unique paddy-cum-pisciculture system practised by the indigenous Apatani tribe

ARB17.claim: The four-day Ziro Festival brings music, dance and Apatani tradition to the valley.

evidence.quote: most notably the annual four-day Ziro Festival

ARB18.claim: Bomdila Monastery (GRL), set up in 1965, has three sections; Bomdila is 160 km from Tezpur and 340 km from Guwahati.

evidence.quote: Established in 1965 and inspired by South Tibet’s Tsona Gontse Monastery
It is approximately 160 km from Tezpur and 340 km from Guwahati.

ARB19.claim: Tezpur airport, 160 km away, is nearest; Rangapara North station is about 95 km.

evidence.quote: Tezpur Airport (TEZ) is the nearest airport, situated about 160 km from Bomdila.
Rangapara North Railway Station (RGPP) is the nearest major railhead, located approximately 95 km from Bomdila.

ARB20.claim: Sela Pass, at 4,170 m, links Tawang with Dirang and the rest of India; it is 78 km from Tawang.

evidence.quote: It has an elevation of 4170 m (13,700 ft) and connects the Indian Buddhist town of Tawang to Dirang
is situated at a distance of 78 km from Tawang town

ARB21.claim: The BRO keeps the pass open, but snow can close it temporarily; the Sela Tunnel was built as an all-weather route.

evidence.quote: While the Border Roads Organization (BRO) of India works to keep the pass open throughout the year, it may shut down temp
Government of India announced the funding for construction of all weather road transport tunnel

ARB22.claim: Tourists need special permits, usually arranged through registered tour operators in Tawang.

evidence.quote: tourists need special permits, and travel is typically arranged through registered tour operators in Tawang

ARB23.claim: The best time to visit Bomdila is spring (March–April) and autumn (October–November).

evidence.quote: The best time to visit Bomdila is during spring (March–April) and autumn (October–November)

ARB24.claim: The best time to visit Dirang is March to June or October to November.

evidence.quote: The best time to visit Dirang is between March and June or October and November.

evidence.quote: The best time to visit Pasighat is between October and April
The nearest airport is Dibrugarh Airport in Assam, located about 150 km away

evidence.quote: The best time to visit Roing is between October and April
The nearest airport is Dibrugarh Airport (DIB), located approximately 140–150 km away
The closest railway stations are Dibrugarh and Tinsukia

ARB27.claim: Elevation runs 100–2,000 m; the best time is November to March. Tezpur is about 64 km away.

evidence.quote: between 100 and 2,000 meters above sea level
The best time to visit Pakke Tiger Reserve is between November and March
The nearest major town is Tezpur , located approximately 64 km away

ARB28.claim: The best birding is in March and April; Tezpur airport is about 120 km, then 5–6 hours by road via Bhalukpong.

evidence.quote: The best time to observe birds at Eaglenest is during March and April.

ARB29.claim: It has about 60 mammal and over 200 bird species; best October–March.

with over 200 species recorded

ARB30.claim: Accommodation in Itanagar, Ziro and Pasighat ranges from budget hotels to guest houses, homestays and hotels.

ARB8.claim: Naharlagun station is about 100 km from Ziro; APSRTC buses, shared sumos and taxis run from Itanagar, Naharlagun and Guwahati, 445–470 km away.

evidence.quote: Naharlagun Railway Station (NLG) is the nearest major railway station, situated about 100 km from Ziro.
445–470 km from Guwahati
Regular buses operated by the Arunachal Pradesh State Road Transport Corporation, along with shared sumos and taxis, operate from Itanagar, Naharlagun, and Guwahati to Ziro.

itineraries.title: Itanagar and Ziro in 4 days: Ita Fort and the Apatani valley
itineraries.summary: Arunachal's capital and its brick fort, then the Ziro valley — Apatani villages, paddy-cum-fish farms, pine groves and the Talley Valley sanctuary.
itineraries.seoTitle: Itanagar and Ziro 4-Day Itinerary, Arunachal Pradesh
itineraries.seoDescription: 4 days from Itanagar to Ziro: Ita Fort and the state museum, Apatani villages and Tarin Fish Farm, Kile Pakho and Talley Valley — with eILP rules and travel times.

plan.overview: A short loop through central Arunachal. Start in Itanagar, named after its 14th–15th-century brick fort, then drive to the Ziro plateau at about 1,500 m, home of the Apatani and their rice-and-fish terraces. Indian visitors need a tourist eILP; foreign visitors need a PAP through an approved tour operator.
plan.start: Itanagar (Donyi Polo airport at Hollongi, or Naharlagun station)
plan.season: Spring (March–May) or autumn (September–November) for Ziro; October–April for Itanagar
plan.transport: Hired car, or APSRTC bus or shared sumo to Ziro.

guides.title: How to reach and get around Arunachal Pradesh
guides.summary: Permits first: the eILP for Indians and the PAP for foreign visitors. Then the airports, stations and roads into Tawang, Itanagar, Ziro, Pasighat and Roing.
guides.seoTitle: How to Reach Arunachal Pradesh: Permits, Airports, Roads
guides.seoDescription: Getting into Arunachal Pradesh: eILP for Indians, PAP for foreigners, the airports for Tawang, Itanagar and Ziro, Sela Pass and the Bumla permit.

body.intro: Arunachal Pradesh needs a permit before anything else. After that, the state is reached from Assam: Tezpur for the Tawang road, Hollongi or Naharlagun for Itanagar and Ziro, and Dibrugarh for Pasighat and Roing.

items.title: Indian citizens
items.body: A tourist eILP, valid for stays of up to 14 days. Children under 14 travel with an accompanying adult.

items.title: Foreign nationals
items.body: A PAP or RAP, applied for through an approved local tour operator, plus a USD 30 royalty per head.

items.title: Bumla Pass
items.body: Needs a special permit, usually arranged through registered tour operators in Tawang.

items.title: By air
items.body: Guwahati and Tezpur are the nearest airports; Tezpur is 160 km from Bomdila.

items.title: By rail
items.body: Rangapara North is about 95 km from Bomdila.

items.title: Sela Pass
items.body: At 4,170 m and 78 km from Tawang. Snow can close it for a time; the Sela Tunnel is the all-weather route.

items.title: Itanagar
items.body: Donyi Polo airport at Hollongi, Lilabari and Jorhat are the nearest airports; Naharlagun is the station.

items.title: Ziro
items.body: Hollongi is about 135 km (3–4 hours) and Lilabari about 123 km (4–5 hours); Naharlagun station is about 100 km. APSRTC buses, shared sumos and taxis run from Itanagar, Naharlagun and Guwahati.

sections.heading: Pasighat and Roing
sections.text: Dibrugarh airport in Assam is about 150 km from Pasighat and about 140–150 km from Roing.

sections.heading: Where to stay
sections.text: Itanagar, Ziro and Pasighat have budget hotels, guest houses, homestays and hotels. The Tawang circuit, from Jang to Zemithang, has hotels, homestays, guest houses and government lodges.

checklist: Get your eILP or PAP before you travel.
Check whether Sela Pass is open.
Book Bumla through a registered Tawang operator.

guides.title: Best time to visit Arunachal Pradesh: place by place
guides.summary: Spring and autumn for the Tawang road and Ziro, October to April for the lower valleys, and the best months for birding and wildlife.
guides.seoTitle: Best Time to Visit Arunachal Pradesh: Tawang, Ziro
guides.seoDescription: When to visit Arunachal Pradesh: spring and autumn for Tawang, Bomdila and Ziro, October–April for Itanagar and Pasighat, and the best months for Eaglenest and Pakke.

body.intro: Arunachal climbs from the Assam plains to high Himalayan passes, so the best time depends on where you go. The lower valleys suit October to April; the mountain road to Tawang and the Ziro plateau are best in spring and autumn.

items.title: Dirang
items.body: March to June or October to November.

items.title: Ziro
items.body: Spring (March–May) and autumn (September–November); the Ziro Music Festival is in September.

sections.heading: Snow on Sela Pass
sections.text: The BRO keeps Sela Pass open, but snow can close it for a time; the Sela Tunnel was built as the all-weather route.

checklist: Pick spring or autumn for Tawang and Ziro.
Check Sela Pass before you drive.
